01Method

How a Refill product earns its label.

  1. 01

    Literature first

    Every formulation starts in the clinical literature — meta-analyses, guidelines (ESPEN, ASPEN), and disease-specific evidence set the spec before any ingredient is sourced.

  2. 02

    Formulation as engineering

    Bioavailability, substrate ratios, osmolality, tolerance — the variables are quantified, then locked. A spec that cannot be defended is not produced.

  3. 03

    Clinician feedback loops

    Products live in wards, not slide decks. We iterate with the professionals who prescribe, dose, and observe — their protocols are our test bench.

  4. 04

    Technology for measurement

    Devices and applications close the loop: delivery is controlled, tolerance is observed, outcomes are recorded. Nutrition therapy that isn't measured is guesswork.
